environment.mode: isolated production renderer build; offline HTTP fixtures; no business backend writes

scope: Repeated real Studio revision restores with one active mixed-arena canvas, 120 text children, actual live/docs code generation and a protected second codegen context. GC twice before each heap sample. Separate snapshots; serial fresh processes for formal comparisons. Both arms contain the PropEditorRow disposal guard.

adoption.codegenCacheOwnershipPrototype: rejected; modest additional heap reduction and old Site retention persists

functionality.note: Baseline also passes behavior checks; leak detection relies on heap paths/WeakRefs, not on these behavior assertions.

checks.eslint: root node_modules/.bin/eslint, 3 changed production files, --quiet: passed
checks.syntax: node --check for diagnostic CJS files passed

boundaries: JS used heap of Studio CDP target; not total App memory, RSS, native or GPU memory
Codegen timing only; not Preview reopen latency, canvas first paint, total CPU or OS input latency
No actual Docs editor UI interaction, complete draft-recovery scenario, authentication, library upgrade/publish or remote backend validation in this experiment
Remaining Site retention and no-snapshot latest two old documents are not claimed fully solved; separate snapshot run releases the tracked old documents
